blocks.x: The fourth comprehensive form of ziyarah is the previously cited form known as Ziyarah Aminullah. It has been placed as the second form of ziyarah of Imam ‘Ali Amir al-Mu’minin (‘a). This form begins with the following statement:
السّلام عليك يا امين اللّه فى ارضه و حجته على عباده اشهد انّك جاهدت فى اللّه
This comprehensive form begins with the following statement:
الحمد للّه الذى اشهدنا مشهد اوليائه فى رجب
This form has been previously cited within the rites in Rajab. The total of the comprehensive forms of ziyarah has been five in number. These forms will be sufficient, Allah willing.
